primary_text: "I'm paying more in rent every year and getting nothing to show for it. Dead money." Industrial rents in Melbourne's west have surged and landlords aren't slowing down. Every increase eats directly into your margin. Right now, there's a narrow window to secure an off-the-plan warehouse in Truganina at today's price before construction costs push values higher. These are selling fast to owner-occupiers who are done paying someone else's mortgage. Near Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and Port of Melbourne. Don't wait for next year's rent review.
description: Secure today's price before construction costs and rents climb further
